name: RC-B10-0392/2025 – After § 4 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text: 4a. Recalls that human rights violations linked to the Rwandan authorities are not limited to actions within Rwanda’s borders, but also extend to the neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo, where multiple UN reports have implicated Rwanda in providing military and logistical support to the M23 rebel group, responsible for serious atrocities, including massacres of civilians, sexual violence, and mass displacement in eastern Congo;
